svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for Design Systems. On a dotted floor, a long low tray with a lime rim lies across the front holding five small parts: a button, a text field, a switch, a tick box and a card. Behind it, three screens float side by side. One shows a table, one a form and one a set of cards, but all three share the same blue top strip and the same blue button. Dashed lines rise from the tray's button to each screen's button. Under each screen a solid blue Tcules person leans in with a fingertip on it.
